note: Top-9 by upvotes for HF Daily Papers, week 2026-W29. Each book ingests its arXiv paper via generator/paper.mjs (real figures downloaded to public/generated/<slug>/figures/), embeds the paper's own diagrams/charts with the Figure primitive, and hand-animates that paper's key results chart as a native viz. Books are authored ONE AT A TIME (see .claude/skills/new-series). Book 1 (dp-harness-handbook) is authored in full as the template.

books.title: The Harness Handbook
books.subtitle: Making an evolving agent harness readable, navigable, editable
books.chart: Fig. 3 — win-rate + token-cost bars (Codex +10.0, Terminus +18.9; tokens -12.7% / -8.6%)
books.subsystem: Ground in the paper's own structure: behavior localization as the central bottleneck in harness evolution; the three-level progressive-disclosure Handbook (L1 System Overview, L2 Component Overview, L3 Unit Deep Dive) shown in Fig. 1; the three-phase construction pipeline (static fact extraction -> propose/review behavioral mapping -> handbook synthesis) in Fig. 2; and the Fig. 3 results comparing Baseline vs Handbook-Assisted planning.

books.title: LongStraw
books.subtitle: Long-context RL beyond 2M tokens on a fixed GPU budget
books.chart: training throughput / context-length scaling under fixed GPU budget
books.subsystem: Explain how LongStraw pushes reinforcement learning past a 2M-token context without growing the GPU budget: the memory/compute bottleneck of long-context RL, the mechanism that keeps the budget fixed as context grows, and the reported scaling results. Embed the paper's system + results figures; re-animate the context-vs-budget curve.

books.title: VideoChat3
books.subtitle: A fully open, efficient generalist video MLLM
books.chart: benchmark win-rates across video understanding tasks
books.subsystem: Explain VideoChat3 as a fully-open video multimodal LLM: how it ingests video efficiently (token/frame budgeting), the generalist architecture, and its benchmark results. Embed the architecture + benchmark figures; re-animate the benchmark comparison bars.

books.title: Boogu-Image 0.1
books.subtitle: Agentic multimodal generation on a minimal budget
books.subsystem: Explain how Boosting understanding improves open agentic multimodal image generation under a minimal compute budget: the understanding-then-generate loop, the budget frontier, and results. Embed the pipeline + sample figures; re-animate the quality-vs-budget frontier.

books.title: Weak to Strong
books.subtitle: Generalization via direct on-policy distillation
books.subsystem: Explain weak-to-strong generalization by direct on-policy distillation: how a weaker teacher's on-policy signal lifts a stronger student past the teacher, why on-policy matters, and the empirical curves. Embed the method + results figures; re-animate the student-surpasses-teacher curve.

books.title: Function-Aware FIM
books.subtitle: Fill-in-the-middle as mid-training for coding agents
books.chart: coding-benchmark gains from function-aware FIM mid-training
books.subsystem: Explain function-aware fill-in-the-middle as a mid-training objective for coding-agent foundation models: how spanning whole functions (not arbitrary spans) shapes the objective, the mid-training placement, and coding results. Embed the objective + results figures; re-animate the benchmark gains.

books.title: ABot-N1
books.subtitle: Toward a general visual-language navigation foundation model
books.subsystem: Explain ABot-N1 as a general visual-language navigation foundation model: how instructions + egocentric vision drive navigation, the training recipe, and cross-environment success rates. Embed the architecture + trajectory figures; re-animate the success-rate comparison.

books.title: Ring-Zero
books.subtitle: Scaling zero-RL to a trillion parameters for emergent reasoning
books.subsystem: Explain Ring-Zero: scaling zero-RL (RL from scratch, no SFT warmup) to a trillion-parameter model and the emergent reasoning that appears. Cover the zero-RL setup, the scaling, and the emergence curves. Embed the system + emergence figures; re-animate the emergence-vs-scale curve.

books.title: SEED
books.subtitle: Self-evolving on-policy distillation for agentic RL
books.subsystem: Explain SEED's self-evolving on-policy distillation loop for agentic reinforcement learning: how the model distills from its own improving policy round over round, why that compounds, and the agentic-task results. Embed the loop + results figures; re-animate the reward-over-rounds curve.
